desc:
Brand: Bugles (a General Mills product)

Flavor: Classic Ranch

Pack Size: Individual 3 oz bag; typically sold in multi-packs of six

Snack Type: Crispy corn snack in the signature cone-shaped
features:
Features

Ranch Flavor: Bold and tangy ranch seasoning adds a zesty twist to every bite.

Cone-Shaped Snack: The fun, funnel-like design is great for both eating and dipping.

Light & Crispy Texture: Made from degermed yellow cornmeal, fried for a satisfying crunch.

Single-Serve Bag: Each 3 oz pack is ideal for individual consumption or on-the-go snacking.

Convenient Packaging: Easy to store, carry, and enjoy without mess or preparation. 

Benefits

Fun and Flavorful: Combines playful shapes with rich ranch taste for a unique snacking experience.

Great for All Ages: Loved by both kids and adults; makes snack time enjoyable for the whole family.

Perfect for Lunches and Trips: Compact bag size makes it easy to toss into lunchboxes, backpacks, or purses.

Snack Without the Guilt: Contains no trans fats or cholesterol—just crispy, satisfying crunch.

Perfect Party Snack: Great for sharing at parties, movie nights, or casual get-togethers.
ingredients:
Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Vegetable Oil (coconut, palm, and/or palm kernel), Sugar. Contains 2 % or less of: Dried Buttermilk, Salt, Maltodextrin, Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Dextrose, Monosodium Glutamate, Citric Acid, Onion Powder, Parsley, Modified Corn Starch, Disodium Guanylate and Inosinate, Natural And Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by BHT.

Contains milk; may contain wheat ingredients.
